assets.recommended_scale_usage: Place at 1344 px width on a 1920x1080 battle screen; center on screen unless layout requires offset.
assets.notes: Cards and dynamic content are intentionally removed. Title plaque is blank for runtime text/art text layering.

nine_slice_notes.recommended: Use this as a whole modal frame when possible. If 9-slicing is needed, keep hanging tags/tassels, close button, title plaque, and bottom medallion as overlays rather than stretching them.
non_stretch_overlays: side hanging command tokens and tassels
